description: REPS Time helps real estate investors track hours worked on their short-term rental properties to qualify for IRS Real Estate Professional Status (750 hours/year of material participation). Log activities, review your properties, check your progress toward the 750-hour threshold, and sync calendar events — all from chat. Ideal for STR owners, co-hosts, and their accountants who need an audit-ready record of qualifying hours.

defaultPrompt: Log 2 hours I spent inspecting my rental property this morning
